sources.assets.ts: import {sha256Canonical} from "../core/digest.js";export interface AssetVersion{id:string;assetId:string;version:number;blobRef:string;digest:string;mime:string;parentVersionIds:string[];createdAt:string}export class AssetRegistry{private versions=new Map<string,AssetVersion[]>();add(v:Omit<AssetVersion,"digest"> & {digest?:string}){const list=this.versions.get(v.assetId)??[];if(list.some(x=>x.version===v.version))throw new Error("version exists");const x={...v,digest:v.digest??sha256Canonical({blobRef:v.blobRef,mime:v.mime})};list.push(Object.freeze(x));this.versions.set(v.assetId,list);return x}get(assetId:string,version:number){return this.versions.get(assetId)?.find(v=>v.version===version)}lineage(assetId:string){return this.versions.get(assetId)??[]}}
